description: Suggest time slots within a window when ALL given attendees are free, based on their free/busy availability. Returns candidate start/end times in the resolved timezone that can be passed directly to create_event. Include your own email address in attendees to account for your own availability. A slot is only suggested when availability for EVERY requested attendee was resolved; otherwise no slots are returned and the unresolved attendees are listed in unresolvableAttendees.

attendees.description: Email addresses whose availability must all be free

deviceTimezone.description: User's device IANA timezone from system prompt (e.g. "Europe/London"). Used to interpret the window if calendar settings unavailable.

endDateTime.description: End of the search window (ISO format)

maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of candidate slots to return, 1-20 (default: 5)

startDateTime.description: Start of the search window (ISO format)

name: find_meeting_times
